findings.title: Published enhanced record lacks accountable approval metadata
findings.evidence: The published record has no reviewer name, role, UTC review time, candidate fingerprint, or preserved uncertainty decision.
findings.requiredAction: Reconstruct an evidence packet, complete human editorial review, and promote the unchanged fingerprint through the standard decision ledger before closing Phase 9.3.

findings.title: Legacy state vote label differs from the reviewed vocabulary
findings.evidence: The record uses “Final passage”; reviewed Nevada batches use the public label “Passage.” The meanings do not conflict, but the presentation is inconsistent.
findings.requiredAction: Confirm and normalize the label as part of the record's next accountable editorial review.

findings.title: Missing sponsor entity is explicitly disclosed
findings.evidence: The reviewed AB44 candidate contains an empty sponsor array. The public page now preserves that value and explains that no sponsor entity was captured in the reviewed source snapshot.
findings.requiredAction: Retain the textual fallback and recheck the official record during the next source refresh.
